name: rax_move_base
description: Move the swerve base by [dx metres, dy metres, yaw radians] in its start frame. Separate rotation and translation. Requires calibrated point clouds, lidar tracking and the configured travel posture. doorway_id requires a continuously open, clear doorway. Poll for measured completion.

name: rax_scene
description: Read fresh calibrated point-cloud geometry, lidar pose, panel plane and tracked doorway state. Missing or stale geometry is refused.

name: rax_detect_buttons
description: Detect labels in a new wrist or base camera capture while stationary. Return exact saved image identity and calibrated rays; boxes are label regions, not verified press points.

target_method.description: Optional explicit image-only button-face method. Unsupported or missing target evidence must refuse; no default fallback.

name: rax_camera_ray
description: Project a saved RAX detector capture onto locally supported panel depth.

name: rax_base_preview
description: Check a measured RAX base goal without motion.
